beats.care: Scammers bought data on students who failed MBBS exams and sold them fake certificates. Buyers got arrested too.
beats.what: SP Ajay Kumar Bansal said the department gets up to 10,000 complaints daily and froze over ₹1,600 crore since Oct 2024.
beats.why: That's about 30% of the ₹6,000–7,000 crore people lost to online fraud in that time.
